Build the debug message into one String owned by the debugger pass, hoisted above the paint loop as `let mut message = String::new();` and `message.clear()` per node. Change semantics_debug_message(node, out: &mut String) to `out.push_str(semantic_role_name(node.role));` and `write!(out, ' label={:?}', ...)` in place of format!. Push separators with out.push(' ') rather than Vec<String> plus fields.join(" "). Make bounded_debug_text write into `out` (or return &str slices via char_indices) rather than calling to_owned() on short text. Today each painted node allocates a Vec, several Strings, and the join result, all per frame while the debugger is on.

Stop rebuilding the paint order on every pointer event. Compute the slot order once where sync_render_children orders the painted layers (or when the viewport's paint order or child scopes change, guarded by a generation), store it with the viewport's render state as a Box<[RenderObjectId]>, and return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(&stored) here. The current path allocates twice per hit-tested viewport: sliver_paint_slots (scrolling/geometry.rs:74, a Vec<usize>) and this collect. The allocation happens only when the scopes are mixed and paint_order is not LastIsTop, so confidence in the hot-path cost is medium.
